notes:
Meeting format is to read from the book Alcoholics Anonymous for about 30 minutes. We then open the meeting for discussion on the night's reading.

Holiday Schedule: This is a city owned facility and no meeting will be held when there is a public holiday observed by the city and the facility is closed.

name: Expect A Miracle
notes:
Meeting format is a Big Book Topic Discussion meeting. An A.A. member reads something from the book Alcoholics Anonymous and then shares their experience on the selected reading for about 10 minutes. They then suggest a topic related to the reading for the remaining discussion portion of the meeting.

This is an open meeting of Alcoholics Anonymous and all members of the community are welcome to attend. The single most important aspect of recovery is the principle of one alcoholic relating to another alcoholic, therefore only alcoholics participate in the meeting.

name: Freethinkers
notes:
● Face masks required for unvaccinated attendees

Meeting Format: A round-robin reading of A.A. literature with and without comment by the reader, followed in the second half, by a general discussion of A.A. related topics.

This group of A.A. attempts to maintain a tradition of free expression, and conducts a meeting where alcoholics may feel free to express any doubts or disbelief's they may have, and to share their own personal form of spiritual experience, their search for it, or their rejection of it. We do not endorse or oppose any form of religion or atheism. Our only wish is to assure suffering alcoholics that they can find sobriety in A.A. without having to accept anyone else's beliefs or having to deny their own.
